messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: could not find function "fsr"
parts:
The fsr() function is not 'public'. But you can use it by using
lavaan:::fsr() instead. This is an 'experimental' function, so it may be
less stable then sem().

If you are using 0.6-4 (or higher), you may also try lavaan:::sam()
which soon will supersede lavaan:::fsr()

More information about sam() (paper, documentation) is under preparation.

Yves.
